tool.name: mumemto
tool.description: compute multi-MUMs and multi-MEMs across pangenomes
tool.command:
## Prepare input #if str($input_selector.mode) == "direct": #for $i, $fasta in enumerate($input_selector.input_fasta): ln -s '$fasta' 'seq_${i}.fa' && #end for #for $i, $fasta in enumerate($input_selector.input_fasta): echo 'seq_${i}.fa' >> filelist.txt && #end for #else: ln -s '$input_selector.filelist_input' filelist.txt && #end if
mumemto -i filelist.txt -o 'output' -l $l #if str($k): -k $k #end if -f $f #if str($F): -F $F #end if $no_revcomp $b $M #if str($M) == '-M' and str($n) == '-n': -n #end if -w $advanced.w -m $advanced.m $advanced.g $advanced.K

param.name: input_fasta
param.label: Input FASTA files
param.help: Select two or more genome sequences (one per genome/haplotype)

param.name: filelist_input
param.label: File list
param.help: Text file with one FASTA path per line

param.label: Minimum match length
param.help: Minimum length of a match to report

param.label: Minimum genomes
param.help: Minimum number of sequences a match must appear in. Negative values are relative to N (e.g. -1 = all but one). Default: all sequences.

param.label: Maximum per-sequence frequency
param.help: Maximum occurrences of a match per sequence. 0 = unlimited. Default: 1 (unique matches).

param.label: Maximum total frequency
param.help: Maximum total occurrences across all sequences. Negative values are relative to N. Default: unlimited.

param.label: Exclude reverse complement matches
param.help: By default, mumemto includes reverse complement matches. Enable this to exclude them.

param.label: Output binary BUMbl format
param.help: Produce a .bumbl binary file in addition to the text .mums file. Note: only available for strict multi-MUMs (f=1).

param.label: Output mergeable metadata
param.help: Produce .thresh files for downstream partition merging. Note: only available for strict multi-MUMs (f=1).

param.label: Anchor-based merging
param.help: Use anchor-based merging (requires mergeable output above).

param.label: Use gsacak directly
param.help: Use gsacak instead of the built-in suffix array construction.

param.label: Keep temporary files
param.help: Retain PFP intermediate files for debugging.

tool.help:
**What it does**
Mumemto finds maximal unique matches (multi-MUMs) and maximal exact matches (multi-MEMs) across a collection of genome sequences (a pangenome). It uses prefix-free parsing (PFP) for efficient computation.
By default, mumemto computes strict multi-MUMs — matches that appear exactly once in every input sequence. You can relax this with:
- **Minimum genomes (-k):** Require matches in fewer than all sequences. Negative values are relative to N (e.g., -k -1 = all but one). - **Per-sequence frequency (-f):** Allow matches to appear multiple times per sequence (0 = unlimited). - **Max total frequency (-F):** Cap the total number of occurrences across all sequences.
**Input**
Provide a collection of FASTA files (one per genome/haplotype). You can either select multiple FASTA datasets directly or provide a file-list (one path per line).
**Output**
The tool produces:
- A `.mums` file: tab-separated with columns: match length, comma-separated start positions per sequence, comma-separated strand indicators (+/-) - A `.lengths` file: sequence lengths - Optionally a `.bumbl` binary file for faster loading in downstream tools - Optionally `.thresh` files for partition merging
**Downstream tools**
Use the mumemto tool suite for visualization, coverage analysis, collinear block detection, format conversion, sequence extraction, BED conversion, partition merging, and inversion detection.
